about: The action bar is fixed to the bottom of the window and offers the actions for what a person has selected. It opens while anything is selected and leaves focus on the selection. A screen reader announces it once as it opens. Escape inside the bar and its close button clear the selection, and focus returns to the checkbox that opened it.

photos.about: The bar at the end of the window offers four actions. In a narrow window the toolbar moves the two actions without an icon into its More menu and shows only the icon of Download. Share is the primary action and keeps its words.
photos.label: Actions for the selected photos
photos.title: Folding

placement.about: Placement puts the bar at the start, in the middle or at the end of the bottom edge of the window. Start and end follow the writing direction. Select an invoice in a cell to open its bar.
placement.title: Placement
